# Fandom
> Fandom is a community platform hosting fan-created wikis for entertainment, gaming, anime, and pop culture topics.

Fandom combines a large network of community-maintained wikis with platform features for editing, moderation, policy, and developer access. Its core resources include help documentation, community governance pages, API documentation, and major product areas such as Games, TV, Movies, Anime, and Video.

## Main Platform
- [Fandom Home](https://www.fandom.com/): Main entry point for Fandom’s fan wiki platform and content network.
- [Games](https://www.fandom.com/topics/games): Hub for gaming-related fandom content, communities, and featured wiki topics.
- [TV](https://www.fandom.com/topics/tv): Hub for television-related fandom content and community destinations.
- [Movies](https://www.fandom.com/topics/movies): Hub for film-related fandom content and featured fan communities.
- [Anime](https://www.fandom.com/topics/anime): Hub for anime fandom coverage and related community wikis.
- [Video](https://www.fandom.com/video): Video content area featuring fandom-related clips and entertainment coverage.

## Help Center
- [Help Wiki Main Page](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Contents): Central help index for editing, account, and community guidance.
- [Getting Started](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Getting_Started): Introductory guidance for new contributors creating and editing on Fandom.
- [VisualEditor](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:VisualEditor): Documentation for editing pages using Fandom’s visual editing interface.
- [Source Editor](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Source_Editor): Guide to editing wiki pages directly with source markup.
- [Images](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Images): Instructions for uploading, formatting, and managing images on Fandom wikis.
- [Templates](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Templates): Overview of template usage and reuse across wiki pages.
- [Categories](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Categories): Documentation for organizing pages with categories.
- [User Pages](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:User_page): Guidance for creating and maintaining personal user pages.

## Community Governance
- [Community Central](https://community.fandom.com/): Main community governance and support wiki for Fandom users and admins.
- [Community Guidelines](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Community_Guidelines): Core behavioral expectations and standards across Fandom communities.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.fandom.com/terms-of-use): Legal terms governing use of Fandom services and content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.fandom.com/privacy-policy): Policy describing data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [Content Policy](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Content_Policy): Rules and restrictions for acceptable content on Fandom wikis.
- [User Blog:Staff](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/User_blog:Staff): Official staff announcements and platform updates for community members.
- [Requests for Adoption](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Requests_for_adoption): Process for requesting stewardship of inactive or abandoned communities.

## Wiki Management
- [Help:Administration](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Administration): Overview of administrative roles, permissions, and responsibilities.
- [Help:Managing_your_community](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Managing_your_community): Guidance for admins building and maintaining healthy wiki communities.
- [Help:User_rights](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:User_rights): Explanation of user groups, permissions, and access levels.
- [Help:Bureaucrats](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Bureaucrats): Documentation for bureaucrat permissions and community management tasks.
- [Help:Administrators](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Administrators): Documentation for administrator tools and moderation capabilities.
- [Help:Discussions](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Discussions): Information about Fandom discussion features and community conversations.
- [Help:Special_pages](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Special_pages): Reference for MediaWiki special pages available on Fandom.
- [Help:Page_history](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Page_history): Guide to revision history, diffs, and page change tracking.

## Customization and Advanced Editing
- [Help:Wiki markup](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Wiki_markup): Reference for core wiki markup syntax used on Fandom.
- [Help:Parser functions](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Parser_functions): Documentation for parser functions used in advanced page logic.
- [Help:CSS](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:CSS): Guidance for styling wiki content and interface elements with CSS.
- [Help:JavaScript](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:JavaScript): Documentation for adding custom JavaScript behavior to wikis.
- [Help:Portable infoboxes](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Portable_infoboxes): Guide to building and using Fandom’s portable infobox system.
- [Help:Lua](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Lua): Introduction to Lua modules and scripting on Fandom wikis.
- [Help:Tables](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Tables): Instructions for creating and formatting tables in wiki pages.
- [Help:Links](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Links): Reference for internal, external, and interwiki linking behavior.

## Developer Resources
- [Developers Wiki](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/Developers_Wiki): Central developer documentation hub for Fandom platform integrations and APIs.
- [MediaWiki API](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/MediaWiki_API): Overview of MediaWiki API usage on Fandom wikis.
- [Fandom API](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/Fandom_API): Documentation for Fandom-specific API endpoints and platform data access.
- [API:Articles](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/Articles/Api): Reference for article-related API operations and responses.
- [API:Search](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/Search): Documentation for search-related developer capabilities and endpoints.
- [API:Curated Content](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/CuratedContent): Reference for curated content APIs and structured content retrieval.
- [API:Portable Infoboxes](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/Portable_Infoboxes): Developer details for working with portable infobox data and rendering.
- [API:Auth](https://dev.fandom.com/wiki/Authentication): Authentication-related developer guidance for Fandom services.

## Discussions and Social Features
- [Help:Discussions/User Guide](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Discussions/User_Guide): User-facing guide to participating in Fandom discussions.
- [Help:Message Walls](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Message_Wall): Documentation for user message walls and profile communication.
- [Help:Following](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Following): Guide to following users and content activity across Fandom.
- [Help:Notifications](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Notifications): Overview of notification behavior and account activity alerts.
- [Help:Profiles](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Profile): Documentation for user profiles and account presentation.
- [Help:Avatars](https://community.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Avatar): Guidance for setting and managing user avatars.

## Content Discovery
- [Explore](https://www.fandom.com/explore): Discovery area for browsing popular communities and fandom topics.
- [Games Hub](https://www.fandom.com/topics/games): Curated gaming fandom landing page and topic directory.
- [Movies Hub](https://www.fandom.com/topics/movies): Curated movie fandom landing page and topic directory.
- [TV Hub](https://www.fandom.com/topics/tv): Curated television fandom landing page and topic directory.
- [Anime Hub](https://www.fandom.com/topics/anime): Curated anime fandom landing page and topic directory.
- [Sign In](https://www.fandom.com/signin): Account access page for signing in to Fandom services.

- [Careers](https://www.fandom.com/careers): Employment information and open roles across the company.
- [Press](https://www.fandom.com/press): Press resources, announcements, and media-related company information.
